scenes.text: One second stretched until it held weather, distance, and its own horizon.
scenes.query: one glowing second expanding into a complete alien landscape with storms, mountains, and a curved impossible horizon

scenes.text: The present split open. Behind it stood every past moment and every moment I had not reached.
scenes.query: the present cracking like glass to reveal layered past and future worlds rotating inside one another

scenes.text: They were nested, like dreams sleeping inside dreams that would someday remember them.
scenes.query: nested dream spheres containing sleepers who dream smaller universes, recursive kaleidoscopic descent, deep psychedelic motion

scenes.text: I saw myself wealthy and hollow. Poor and radiant. Loved by crowds. Unknown and finally honest.
scenes.query: four alternate selves orbiting a crystal center, luxury turning hollow, poverty glowing, crowds dissolving, solitude becoming transparent

scenes.text: None felt imaginary. Each looked back with the wounded dignity of someone I had abandoned.
scenes.query: alternate selves behind translucent doorways reaching toward the viewer as abandoned timelines drift like torn silk

scenes.text: I asked which was real. All were real as possibility. None were promised.
scenes.query: many luminous roads forming and dissolving before they touch the horizon, possibility clouds pulsing above each route

scenes.text: The future was not a destination. It was weather gathering around every choice.
scenes.query: a human figure at a crossroads while psychedelic weather systems spiral from each small gesture and decision

scenes.text: A word became wind. Kindness changed the temperature. Fear darkened an entire season.
scenes.query: spoken breath becoming colored wind, a kind hand warming a frozen landscape, a small dark seed expanding into winter

scenes.text: Every decision rang like a tuning fork. Distant versions of me trembled in response.
scenes.query: a luminous tuning fork sending waves through a cathedral of alternate selves, bodies resonating as geometric color

scenes.text: I saw my death through several doors. Each opened into the same impossible brightness.
scenes.query: many distinct doors at the ends of different lives opening into one gentle impossible radiance, no horror, celestial depth

scenes.text: I saw my birth as eternity narrowing itself enough to become touchable.
scenes.query: infinite cosmic light narrowing through concentric membranes into a newborn hand touching warm human fingers

scenes.text: My life turned inside out. Memory was the shadow of a much larger shape.
scenes.query: a lifetime ribbon turning inside out to reveal a vast multidimensional sculpture casting memories as moving shadows

scenes.text: Something looked backward through me. The future remembered me before I became it.
scenes.query: a radiant future silhouette looking backward through a tunnel of younger selves, gaze traveling against the current of time

scenes.text: Déjà vu was a message sent upstream, a ripple reaching the stone before impact.
scenes.query: a psychedelic river flowing backward as concentric ripples reach a floating stone before impact, time reversing around it

scenes.text: My life was one book. I saw every page, yet still had to turn them one by one.
scenes.query: one open life-book containing all ages simultaneously while a small reader carefully turns a single glowing page

scenes.text: Eternity stopped feeling like endless time. It became the page holding every moment.
scenes.query: all moments becoming inked scenes across one immeasurable luminous page curving around the universe

scenes.text: If the page existed, did choice matter? The answer was deeply human.
scenes.query: a hand hovering above branching ink paths on a cosmic page while the paths wait and shimmer

scenes.text: Choice was not how I escaped infinity. Choice was how infinity acquired texture, consequence, and a point of view.
scenes.query: infinite white light gaining texture as one hand shapes it into landscapes, relationships, wounds, and healing

scenes.text: The present became a needle, drawing one thread through countless possible worlds.
scenes.query: a golden needle sewing one bright timeline through a vast textile of translucent universes, microscopic and cosmic scale

scenes.text: I returned to the room, but tomorrow felt attentive, as though the future listened to how I became it.
scenes.query: the original room restored at dawn, a quiet future silhouette listening beyond the window as fading fractal light rests on ordinary objects
